resource.name: WomensWellnessPlan
resource.title: Women's Wellness Plan
resource.description: Draft FHIR R4 order-set PlanDefinition based on the current SIMS Hospitals Women's Wellness Package page. The page explicitly lists Mammogram, Pap Smear, Thyroid Profile, and CBC; it also says consultation is included. It states no prerequisites and that the package is for women. The consultation is included as a placeholder ServiceRequest activity pending confirmation of its exact type. Validate eligibility, exact thyroid panel composition, and the consultation workflow with the hospital before production use.
resource.purpose: Group ServiceRequest-producing activities for the Women's Wellness package.

action.title: Mammogram
action.description: The package page lists mammogram. Confirm age/risk eligibility, pregnancy/lactation context where relevant, and imaging protocol with the hospital before ordering.

action.title: Pap smear
action.description: The package page lists Pap smear. Confirm cervical screening eligibility, prior screening history, and the appropriate clinical protocol before ordering.

action.title: Thyroid profile
action.description: The package page lists Thyroid Profile but does not specify analytes. Confirm whether this means TSH alone or a panel including free T4/T3 with the hospital laboratory catalog.

action.title: Complete blood count (CBC)
action.description: Confirm the exact coded orderable and clinical workflow with the hospital before production use.

action.title: Women's wellness consultation
action.description: The package page says consultation is included but does not identify the specialty. Confirm the responsible clinician/specialty with the hospital.
